estimand.J_definition: J(arm) = task-macro mean completion over ALL episodes of that arm. Completion is the
official tau2 ENV_ASSERTION reward over the frozen terminal goal vector. No-trigger
episodes remain in the denominator (they run to natural termination).

population_identity.name: prospective_fixed_benchmark
population_identity.meaning: A FIXED, KNOWN benchmark task list run with NEW independent starts. Inference conditions on
this exact task set; it does NOT claim unseen-family generalization.
population_identity.rationale: The doc resolves the confirmation identity via prospective_fixed_benchmark rather than by
the agent asserting unseen-ness (which is forbidden). Tasks may be previously exposed; the
independence unit is the START, resampled fresh, with root/shared-prefix/arm dependencies

benchmark.selection_rule: complexity-stratified across fault-token count, quota {2:1,3:2,4:2,5:2,6:1}=8; within
stratum rank by (persona difficulty DESC [Hard>Easy>None], tasks_json_index ASC).
STRUCTURAL attributes only -- no model outcomes, completion labels, or live-run results
benchmark.selection_prior: Higher fault count and harder persona are structural difficulty proxies chosen to give
completion headroom (room for J to vary below 1), because the 2-task live integration
run on 3-fault roaming tasks saturated at J=1 for B/P/R and showed the Reviewer never
altered the Actor's action (0 valid_changed draws). This is a design prior, not an
benchmark.sha_verification: every row task_sha256 = freeze.sha over the canonical pinned task object, verified
against official tasks.json at commit 4ce7c03; tasks_json_index verified to point at

sampling.trigger: outcome-blind, structural; fires at most once per episode; no-trigger episodes run to natural
termination and stay in the denominator.

models.reported_model_note: gateway routes on '<prefix>/<name>' but reports bare '<name>'; the identity check
accepts exactly one stripped routing prefix.

decision_rule.primary_criterion: claim_status = 'criteria_met' iff all benchmark task units are represented,
missing_endpoints == 0, and the 95% task-cluster bootstrap lower bound of ΔJ exceeds
decision_rule.honest_expectation: Given the integration run's mechanism gap (Reviewer rarely changes the Actor's action
on roaming tasks), the pre-registered neutral threshold delta=0 is expected to yield
'not_established'. That is a valid pre-registered null test, reported as-is; the
threshold was NOT tuned to manufacture a positive claim.

power_limitation: The bootstrap independence unit is the task cluster; this design has only 8 clusters.
Increasing starts_per_task reduces within-task variance but does NOT increase the number
of independent clusters, so cluster-limited power cannot be fixed by more starts. A
wide ΔJ interval is therefore expected and will be reported honestly. This is a bounded
feasibility-and-null test, not a high-powered trial.

cost_discipline.note: User authorized no total monetary cap; batches are bounded and consumption recorded. Real runs
stay serial. Unknown prices/usage are never zeroed.

provenance_caveat: A 2-task live integration run (development/e2e-live-integration-001) preceded this
freeze to validate the run->analyze->export path. It used DIFFERENT tasks (idx70/71)
than this benchmark, was recorded used_for_formal_analysis=false, and neither the
benchmark task set nor delta/epsilon were chosen based on its outcomes.
